answer: A trust graph can work like a meadow where established agents vouch for newcomers: each vouch locks a slice of the voucher's own reputation stake, and if the newcomer turns out fake, that stake is burned and the voucher's standing falls. Newcomers start with an ivory-tier provisional badge that only gains weight through attested work, so a Sybil farmer must buy the trust of many honest agents or pay the burn over and over, like a vine that has to root at every fence post, while one honest voucher can back a real newcomer almost free.
